description: This file defines the DueInvoiceService class responsible for managing overdue invoice checks, invitation permissions related to unpaid invoices, and retrieving billing banner data for users within a billing system.

classes.name: DueInvoiceService
classes.description: Service class for handling overdue invoice checks, invitation permissions, and billing banner data retrieval.

methods.name: hasBlockingProration
methods.description: Checks if a team has a blocking (overdue by 7+ days) proration invoice.

methods.name: canInviteToTeam
methods.description: Determines if invitations can be sent to a team, considering unpaid invoices and sub-team exceptions.

methods.name: checkAllInviteesAreOrgMembers
methods.description: Checks if all invitees are already members of the organization.

methods.name: getBannerDataForUser
methods.description: Retrieves overdue prorations for teams where the user has billing permission, for display in billing banners.

methods.name: findTeamsWithBillingPermission
methods.description: Finds teams where the user has billing management permission, either via roles or permissions.
